svg.aria-label: The layers of the code under internal, highest first; an import goes down, never up, and a test fails when one goes up. cmd: the program, in WSL the launcher (wsl-spawner). front: what people use (cli, tui, api, ui, i18n). app: puts the rest together, once (app, demo). engine: what a stop, a start and a check do (distros, inside, stop, setup, check, history). settings: what people set (config). machine: reads and changes the machine (wsl, winapi, gpo, eventlog). core: safe words and the version, no I/O (plain, version).
